articles.title: This Goldman Sachs Analyst Begins Coverage On A Bullish Note; Here Are Top 5 Initiations For Monday
articles.teaser: Wall Street analysts change outlook on top names including HAWK, ALOY, MP, SUJA, OCTV. For full coverage, see analyst ratings page.
articles.body:
Top Wall Street analysts changed their outlook on these top names. For a complete view of all analyst rating changes, including upgrades, downgrades and initiations, please see our analyst ratings page.

  • Morgan Stanley analyst Kristine Liwag initiated coverage on HawkEye 360 Inc (NYSE:HAWK) with an Overweight rating and announced a price target of $41. HawkEye 360 shares closed at $33.01 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
  • Needham analyst Carter Goman initiated coverage on REalloys Inc (NASDAQ:ALOY) with a Buy rating and announced a price target of $19. REalloys shares closed at $9.16 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
  • Needham analyst Carter Goman initiated coverage on MP Materials Corp (NYSE:MP) with a Buy rating and announced a price target of $81. MP Materials shares closed at $65.18 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
  • Goldman Sachs analyst Bonnie Herzog initiated coverage on Suja Life Inc (NASDAQ:SUJA) with a Buy rating and announced a price target of $31. Suja Life shares closed at $15.43 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
  • Goldman Sachs analyst Gabriela Borges initiated coverage on Octave Intelligence Inc (NASDAQ:OCTV) with a Neutral rating and announced a price target of $17. Octave Intelligence shares closed at $17.20 on Monday. See how other analysts view this stock.
